description: Docker image grouping and labeling preset. Extends the digest pinning already applied in default.json (opt-in).

packageRules.description: Disable minimumReleaseAge for GHCR images. This registry doesn't reliably expose timestamps, causing renovate to skip PR creation.
Group non-major Docker image updates (including digest-only bumps) into a single PR
Major Docker image updates as individual PRs to review breaking changes separately
